description: [AI-slop, Human Play testing] This mod adds both the world type "Real Earth", or the dimension "Earth", which uses real life data to build the world around you. Best effort builds, not striving for 100% realism.

mods.name: Real Earth
mods.description: The real Earth at one block per metre: real elevation, water, roads, railways, towns with their buildings, land cover and climate, as a dimension (a lapis frame lit with a Globe Banner Pattern) or a world type. Map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); building detail (c) Overture Maps Foundation (ODbL); Terrain Tiles (USGS and others); (c) ESA WorldCover 2021 (CC BY 4.0); Koppen-Geiger, Beck et al. 2023 (CC BY 4.0). Full credits: CREDITS.md in the jar, or /earth credits.
